name: Hosea
title: The Prophet of Love
summary: Hosea was a prophet in the Northern Kingdom of Israel who proclaimed God's unwavering love for his unfaithful people. God commanded him to marry the unfaithful Gomer as a symbol of Israel's infidelity. Despite the people's idolatry, Hosea continued to preach God's longing for reconciliation.

keyEvents.title: The Marriage with Gomer
keyEvents.description: God commanded Hosea to marry the unfaithful Gomer as a living symbol of Israel's infidelity toward God.

keyEvents.title: The Symbolic Names of the Children
keyEvents.description: Hosea's children were given prophetic names: Jezreel (judgment), Lo-Ruhama (no compassion), and Lo-Ammi (not my people).

keyEvents.title: Bought Back
keyEvents.description: Hosea bought Gomer back from slavery and loved her despite her infidelity—a picture of God's love.

keyEvents.title: God's Complaint Against Israel
keyEvents.description: Hosea proclaimed God's heartache over Israel's unfaithfulness: 'My people are destroyed for lack of knowledge.'

keyEvents.title: The Promise of Restoration
keyEvents.description: Despite judgment, Hosea promised that God would heal Israel's apostasy and love them from the heart.
